queryDesign.name: TARGET_GATE_SQL
queryDesign.functionSelection: WHERE p.oid = to_regprocedure(the fixed exact signature); no scan of other function definitions, no caller identifiers

projection.functions: exactly one target row, same field names/serialization as CATALOG_SQL.functions
projection.targetAcl: same aclexplode(coalesce(proacl,acldefault)) projection, grantor/grantee/privilege/grantable and identical ordering
projection.effective: same has_function_privilege projection for fixed postgres/authenticated/service_role/anon roles

queryDesign.serialization: Use identical signature construction, oidvectortypes spaces, PG17 SHA256 UTF8 pg_get_functiondef, proacl::text and config representation; do not normalize away differences.

validation: Pass miniature state to unchanged function_check and acl_check using existing finite preflight templates. Missing/duplicate exact target fails.
Every owner/definer/search_path/language/volatility/parallel/leakproof/definition/explicit ACL/effective-permission mismatch stops before observe.
Run unchanged TARGET_DEFINITION_SQL in the same session before observe; verify string, SHA256 UTF8 equals FUNCTION_SHA, plan definitionSha256 and pre-gate target sha256; discard raw definition.
Only after ALL target gate checks succeed, call unchanged observe(session) once.
Retain existing exact ledger/full-state consistency check.

Compare canonical type-sensitive objects containing target(state), targetAcl and effective against pre-gate projection. Compare every field and identical deterministic ACL order. Missing/different data -> PRECHECK_FAILED/CAPTURE_TARGET_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH; no first-read-wins or replacement.
Only after both consistency checks succeed produce the existing safe receipt fields from full state.
sameSnapshot: Existing CaptureTransport owns one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY session; no helper may open a connection/transaction; same session object passed through every query.

receiptCompatibility.queryFamilySha256: Keep existing named entries and add targetGate as one entry in the existing extensible hash map; targetDefinition still denotes same fixed SQL moved earlier. No raw SQL or raw body output.
receiptCompatibility.protectedCatalogFingerprint: Compute from unmodified full observe state only. Do not merge pre-gate-only data into fingerprint input.

authorizationFollowup: After future implementation passes, emit new source-lock and read-only review evidence. Old package digest cannot authorize new checks.py bytes. Obtain explicit fresh user/operator approval binding new package hashes. Existing fixed v2 approval reference remains historical capability lineage; it does not by itself approve changed source bytes. Do not edit old v2 proposal or issue authorization/seal automatically. This design does not change authorization schema or reference path.
